name: Senya
source:
The head of the Rikuka family who has been reincarnated repeatedly for a certain purpose.

A thousand years ago, he was the younger brother of Ukigumo no Hyakuya. He is also Shiou's father in this life.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ignote.net/operetta/tumikui/character.html]official website[/url]]
